title: 발해 어제로 백타임
bodyHtml:
발해 샤드를 살리긴 살렸으나 2월 13일 새벽 6시 시간으로 살려졌다고 합니다. 미안하고 참아줘서 고맙다는군요. ㅡ0ㅡ;;


The Balhae shard has returned to service, but it was necessary to use a backup from February 13 at approximately 6:00am KST (February 12 at 8:00pm UTC/GMT). We never want to see a shard reverted, but unfortunately, in this case it was absolutely necessary. We very much appreciate your patience, and apologize for the inconvenience this interruption may have caused.

http://support.uo.com/s_issue.html
